title: A Thank-You Card

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Mrs. Ruth has been so kind to us: sharing her lambs, her pond, and her stories. Let's make her a thank-you card.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: I pressed these flowers last spring. Each one has its own place on the card.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Lay each pressed flower gently in the place that fits its shape.
steps.hint: Watch: the daisy goes here. Can you find the next?

feedback.mismatch: That one doesn't fit there. Look closely at the shape.
feedback.all_good: What a lovely card! Mrs. Ruth will be so pleased.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Now it's ready. Would you like to give it to Mrs. Ruth yourself? She's at the well in the village.

journal_line: I made a thank-you card for Mrs. Ruth with Miss Miriam, with pressed flowers and a heart.
unavailable_text: The card is made. Mrs. Ruth will love it.
